'''Ammi Pierce''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Gardners' Place]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Luck]]
*+1 [[Will]]

Any Phase: [[Exhaust]] instead of losing 1 [[Sanity]].  Discard Ammi Pierce if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.


==Mythos Source==
Ammi Pierce appeared in ''The Colour Out of Space'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1927).
